name: @liminal/align-agent
description: Align local agent: CLI, daemon, Claude Code and Codex hooks, local metering.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && node ../../scripts/native-libraries.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && { npm run test:concurrent; s=$?; npm run test:serial && exit $s; }
